acceptance.promotion: local development worktree only; no qualification, release or auto-routing claim
acceptance.shared_source_guard: reviewed v9 and mutation tests pass

allocation_source_companion.change: Only version fields, fe/cmg.rs token/literal identity, the existing setup-error format site owner moving to the seeded-capable implementation, and fe/mod.rs private re-export identity change. Direct allocation-site count remains 42; the new PPML-only buffer calls the existing fallible zero_vec helper. Its full capacity is separately charged by both early public and retained engine memory admission. OLS one-shot, wiring and F0 seams are unchanged.

baseline: Preserved dirty main with worker-aligned batches, certified nuisance warm starts and guarded weak-edge grouping; not the clean base commit.
notes: Local macOS diagnostic timings only, run serially. Final-prefixed runs use the retained final artifact. Preliminary controls-prefixed runs preceded final capacity/validity checks; the all-RHS trial is explicitly rejected.

Only frozen controls are seeded. Current weights, graph, hierarchy, RHS and initial/terminal residuals are freshly recomputed. Raw core potentials are retained before nuisance correction in the frozen finite basis order; the working response is cold.

The all-RHS prototype passed final science through the existing fail-closed retry but regressed K0 from 0.312 to 0.489 seconds and K50 from 1.042 to 1.173 seconds. A seeded response triggered one per-RHS certificate retry, nuisance rebuild and later oversolving. It was removed, not retained behind a switch.

Each seed family consumes validity before use and requires finite guesses, a normalized weight transition in [1,2], no own extra PCG restart and useful fresh initial-residual reduction on prior seeded solves. Promotion requires every per-RHS and combined certificate and no tighter frame retry. Checkpoint commit, basis replacement, invalid input and failures reset both families.

One fit-owned core-vertices-by-active-controls buffer is preflighted before allocation, with exact retained-capacity checking. It is overwritten while invalid and committed without allocation. K0 has no control-potential elements. No stale residual, hierarchy or Schur factor is reused.
A warm batch stops before the response; the response uses the original cold API. Cold frames retain original batching. All actual split batches, first/retry work and fallback remain reported.

Public iterations retain maximum-RHS units including setup. New private projection traces additionally sum all PCG RHS iterations and distinguish warm work, fresh residual recomputations and RHS/PCG time. Fine-graph matvecs = iterations + restarts + warm RHSs, excluding recursive preconditioning and independent certificates.
The exact baseline binary predates summed control-iteration telemetry. Its per-frame maximum iterations and phase times are reported; no baseline summed operator count is fabricated.

Nine same-data interleaved pairs confirm the primary benefit (1.004/0.957 seconds before/after) and a small narrow zero-nuisance K10 cost (0.320/0.326). The latter is consistent with the split cold-response batch and remains in the evidence; no tolerance or benchmark is changed to hide it.

The initial balanced-two-FE K50 timing outlier (0.757/0.796) is retained alongside its interleaved confirmation (0.754/0.762). The unchanged LSMR nuisance63/K0 outlier (0.106/0.112) is also retained, with confirmation 0.115/0.116. These are diagnostic confirmations, not an F0 gate or release qualification.

The final source rebuilt to the identical benchmarked artifact after comment clarification; full workspace, serialized FFI, strict Clippy, formatting and source-contract tests were rerun on that final source.
Sparse CMG nuisance probes explicitly override only the third FE width in the existing generator and carry distinct scope/data identities; they are not the high-cardinality sparse-three-FE LSMR case.
No scientific tolerance, rank policy, exact final Hessian identity, checkpoint authority, public solver syntax, OLS route, CMG dependency pin or auto-routing rule changed.

new_boundaries: Seed initialization, finite guards, exact capacity, overflow, factor-two boundaries and weight jumps, residual-quality/extra-restart rejection and allocation-free consumption/promotion/reset.

24,000-row/960-core-vertex weighted three-FE projections: all six permutations, changing weights and an eightfold jump, one/seven threads, independent CG and full-FE certification; warm as well as cold projections bitwise equal across permutations.
Same-operator seeded controls independently certify with zero warm iterations while the response remains cold; corrupt seed and checkpoint reset use cold solves.

Both nuisance and control eligibility checked after selective retry, post-projection numerical failure, allocation/interruption/internal failures, topology change, explicit checkpoint reset and active-basis replacement.
